title: Appliance Standby Waste Watch
dataSources: Carbon estimates (`carbon:estimate`), recycling weight (`recycling:weight`), food waste (`foodwaste:log`), repairs (`repair:event`).
app: Sustainability telemetry — carbon-footprint apps, home recycling scales, food-waste logs, and repair / reuse journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=carbon:estimate category=standby_power
| stats sum(kwh) as standby_kwh, sum(co2e_kg) as standby_co2e by appliance
| sort - standby_co2e
description: Ranks appliances by wasted energy and emissions from standby draw instead of active use.
value: Standby power is invisible on bills and habits alike; this makes the silent waste visible and comparable.
implementation: Ingest standby power estimates with appliance labels and sum wasted kWh and CO2e by device.
visualization: Bar chart of standby emissions by appliance.

references.title: EPA — reducing wasted food at home

grandmaExplanation: It logs which devices keep sipping power and wasting energy even when you are not really using them.
